messages:
mira: heads-up — planning a staggered apply for the staging change window tomorrow 06:00-08:00 UTC. Need to coordinate KMS rotation canary + shadow traffic shift.
jasper: +1. What's the carve-up? serial AZs or service groups?
kai: service groups. small batch for auth, then data-plane, then edge. canary in 2% shadow first 15m.
mira: exact plan: 1) auth (2 hosts) apply -> smoke -> 2) data-plane (3 hosts) apply -> smoke -> 3) edge (roll by AZ). If any error, rollback ladder immediately.
leia: add note: billing job needs pin to old IAM role until KMS completes. otherwise we'll hit 403s.
jasper: good catch. we'll pin provider in the apply var file: provider_version = "~> 4.5.0" and keep the checkout isolated.
mira: deploybot: queue apply for staging with tag "staging-shadow-1759" and hold for manual approval after auth smoke.
deploybot: queued apply 1759-staging-shadow: awaiting manual approval from @mira and @jasper :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
ops-bot: FYI automated alerting profile set to high for this window. Pager threshold lowered to P1 for 5m spike.
kai: rollback ladder: 1) immediate terraform apply destroy-block? no — prefer terraform rollback to previous module version + revoke KV cache. 2) if degraded >10% latency after 5m, cut traffic back to live model and pin to prior infra.
mira: agreed. escalation: @kai -> @leia -> oncall. If turn-back needed, use this command:
```
# revert to previous workspace
terraform workspace select prod; terraform apply -var-file=prev-lock.tfvars -auto-approve
```
jasper: plan to snapshot KV caches and pre-warm after apply. also run a dryrun locally with the exact tfvars used:
```
terraform plan -var-file=staging-shadow.tfvars > plan.out
```
mira: QA: will run smoke set: auth login, token refresh, billing write. QA has signed off on tests in test-matrix doc.
leia: I'll push the billing role pin to the ops repo now and leave a revert PR ready.
deploybot: manual approval request from @mira @jasper received. Approve to proceed? (approve/reject)
mira: approve — proceeding with auth canary in 5.
jasper: monitoring hooks ready. logs aggregation set to 1s flush for 15m.
mira: post-apply checklist: verify 200 logins/min, billing write success, and no 5xx on edge for 10m. then ramp shadow from 2% -> 10% -> 50% over 30m.
kai: note: we'll keep provider pin for 24h then evaluate rolling to newer provider after full pass.
leia: billing pin pushed: PR #402 ready, merging right after auth smoke passes.
mira: thanks team. will post final runbook in the release notes channel after completion. :rocket:
